quotes.quote: Without music, life would be a mistake.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Twilight of the Idols

quotes.quote: One good thing about music, when it hits you, you feel no pain.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: All art constantly aspires towards the condition of music.
quotes.author: Walter Pater

quotes.quote: I'm kind of a good girl - and I'm not. I'm a good girl because I really believe in love, integrity, and respect. I'm a bad girl because I like to tease. I know that I have sex appeal in my deck of cards. But I like to get people thinking. That's what the stories in my music do.
quotes.author: Katy Perry

quotes.quote: We hope that eventually there would be an occasion which I can personally prove that game music can in fact impress many different people and move them.
quotes.author: Nobuo Uematsu

quotes.quote: Music is love, love is music, music is life, and I love my life. Thank you and good night.
quotes.author: A. J. McLean

quotes.quote: I'm inspired by artists and musicians. There are so many wonderful and talented people in the world. I love discovering new music, new writers, or new art.
quotes.author: Alicia Keys

quotes.quote: Music happens to be an art form that transcends language.
quotes.author: Herbie Hancock

quotes.quote: My success set me up for life, and it meant that I could retire from the music industry at 27 to spend time with my newborn daughter and my wife. My time away from the spotlight allowed me to rediscover my love for music, and I'm doing it for me now and no one else.
quotes.author: Rick Astley

quotes.quote: Music is as integral to me as my own DNA. My life has become a continual soundtrack, with music underscoring the most powerful and even the most banal moments of my life.
quotes.author: Danielle de Niese

quotes.quote: If you look back, Mozart, Haydn and Beethoven were mixing music and humor all the time.
quotes.author: Richard Hyung-ki Joo

quotes.quote: I'm happy to be on a winning team. My individual success, that lasts for a short period of time. The success of being a part of the South, of Atlanta, which is now the hot bed of music, that's what's gonna last the longest. The fact that I contributed to planting our flag and moving music to my city, that's what I'm most proud of.
quotes.author: T.I.

quotes.quote: Music has the power to bring people together like no other art form.
quotes.author: Michael Franti

quotes.quote: They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.
quotes.author: Charlie Parker

quotes.quote: I'm into sincerity in music and sincerity in art. If it doesn't feel true, I don't want to do it. Things that are too dramatic scare me. I think that's why I don't always fit into the world of performing arts.
quotes.author: Zooey Deschanel

quotes.quote: Because it's so easy to medicate our need for self-worth by pandering to win followers, 'likes' and view counts, social media have become the metier of choice for many people who might otherwise channel that energy into books, music or art - or even into their own Web ventures.
quotes.author: Neil Strauss

quotes.quote: I've always had a sick sense of humor, and I've always wanted that to permeate the music because I don't take myself seriously. I take the music seriously, but I know I'm not God's gift to anyone except my mom.
quotes.author: Josh Homme

quotes.quote: Music expresses that which cannot be put into words and that which cannot remain silent
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: I write some country music. There's a song called 'I Hope You Dance.' Incredible. I was going to write that poem; somebody beat me to it.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: I think music is the greatest art form that exists, and I think people listen to music for different reasons, and it serves different purposes. Some of it is background music, and some of it is things that might affect a person's day, if not their life, or change an attitude. The best songs are the ones that make you feel something.
quotes.author: Eddie Vedder

quotes.quote: Listen to your inner-voice: Surround yourself with loving, nurturing people. Fall in love with your art and find yourself. Music is the great communicator.
quotes.author: Glenn Hughes

quotes.quote: I'm a people person, very approachable. I go out every night, tons of functions. I love all facets of this industry... Music, film, TV, books, art. I love being around creative people.
quotes.author: Guy Oseary

quotes.quote: Music is God's gift to man, the only art of Heaven given to earth, the only art of earth we take to Heaven.
quotes.author: Walter Savage Landor

quotes.quote: I have never denied my background or my culture. I have taught my child to embrace her Mexican heritage, to love my first language, Spanish, to learn about Mexican history, music, folk art, food, and even the Mexican candy I grew up with.
quotes.author: Salma Hayek

quotes.quote: I feel like skateboarding is as much of a sport as a lifestyle, and an art form, so there's so much that that transcends in terms of music, fashion, and entertainment.
quotes.author: Tony Hawk

quotes.quote: Yes, the Bible should be taught in our schools because it is necessary to understand the Bible if we are to truly understand our own culture and how it came to be. The Bible has influenced every part of western culture from our art, music, and history, to our sense of fairness, charity, and business.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Feelings aroused by the touch of someone's hand, the sound of music, the smell of a flower, a beautiful sunset, a work of art, love, laughter, hope and faith - all work on both the unconscious and the conscious aspects of the self, and they have physiological consequences as well.
quotes.author: Bernie Siegel

quotes.quote: Does art have a future? Performance genres like opera, theater, music and dance are thriving all over the world, but the visual arts have been in slow decline for nearly 40 years. No major figure of profound influence has emerged in painting or sculpture since the waning of Pop Art and the birth of Minimalism in the early 1970s.
quotes.author: Camille Paglia

quotes.quote: Jazz music is America's past and its potential, summed up and sanctified and accessible to anybody who learns to listen to, feel, and understand it. The music can connect us to our earlier selves and to our better selves-to-come. It can remind us of where we fit on the time line of human achievement, an ultimate value of art.
quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis

quotes.quote: My husband John Lennon was a very special man. A man of humble origin, he brought light and hope to the whole world with his words and music.
quotes.author: Yoko Ono

quotes.quote: The human soul is hungry for beauty; we seek it everywhere - in landscape, music, art, clothes, furniture, gardening, companionship, love, religion, and in ourselves. No one would desire not to be beautiful. When we experience the beautiful, there is a sense of homecoming.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue

quotes.quote: And those who were seen dancing were thought to be insane by those who could not hear the music.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: No matter what is happening in life or in the world - war, natural disaster, poor health, pain, the death of loved ones - if existence is filled with art, music and literature, life will be fulfilling, a joy.
quotes.author: Karen DeCrow

quotes.quote: There hasn't been anything real since grunge. That was the last movement led by music or an art form.
quotes.author: Daphne Guinness

quotes.quote: This above all: to thine own self be true, And it must follow, as the night the day, Thou canst not then be false to any man.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Hamlet

quotes.quote: You don't love someone for their looks, or their clothes, or for their fancy car, but because they sing a song only you can hear.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: I would love to make my music and be completely anonymous, but that doesn't work. You can't have success and be faceless.
quotes.author: Sarah McLachlan

quotes.quote: But maybe music was not intended to satisfy the curious definiteness of man. Maybe it is better to hope that music may always be transcendental language in the most extravagant sense.
quotes.author: Charles Ives

quotes.quote: There are a lot of musicians I've met on Twitter where it was like, 'Hey, I like your music' - and then I ended up meeting them and it turned into a friendship.
quotes.author: Grimes

quotes.quote: I love a lot of things, and I'm pretty much obsessive about most things I do, whether it be gardening, or architecture, or music. I'd be an obsessive hairdresser.
quotes.author: Gates McFadden

quotes.quote: And, in the endThe love you takeis equal to the love you make.
quotes.author: Paul McCartney,  The Beatles Illustrated Lyrics

quotes.quote: A studio is like a meditation room where music is created. And a live performance is the place where the creation of the studio is taken ahead. I love both.
quotes.author: Shreya Ghoshal

quotes.quote: If music be the food of love, play on,Give me excess of it; that surfeiting,The appetite may sicken, and so die.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Twelfth Night

quotes.quote: People haven't always been there for me but music always has.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Love is a friendship set to music.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: None but ourselves can free our minds.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: Music is one of the noblest callings I can think of. It's the highest of all the art forms to me. For example, if my kid said to me, 'I want to give it all up,' whatever it is that they're doing, 'and I want to take my saxophone and go out,' I would say, 'May God go with you. This is a great and noble thing that you're doing.'
quotes.author: Hugh Laurie

quotes.quote: Some things don't last forever, but some things do. Like a good song, or a good book, or a good memory you can take out and unfold in your darkest times, pressing down on the corners and peering in close, hoping you still recognize the person you see there.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

quotes.quote: Music is a total constant. That's why we have such a strong visceral connection to it, you know? Because a song can take you back instantly to a moment, or a place, or even a person. No matter what else has changed in your or the world, that one song says the same, just like that moment.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: Music is a moral law. It gives soul to the universe, wings to the mind, flight to the imagination, and charm and gaiety to life and to everything.
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.quote: A love of classical music is only partially a natural response to hearing the works performed, it also must come about by a decision to listen carefully, to pay close attention, a decision inevitably motivated by the cultural and social prestige of the art.
quotes.author: Charles Rosen

quotes.quote: Prosecutors say it would be next to impossible to get one teen to testify in court that another had slipped him or her a copied disc at lunchtime. And besides, isn't sharing music a time-honored part of teen friendship?
quotes.author: Charles Duhigg

quotes.quote: Music was my refuge. I could crawl into the space between the notes and curl my back to loneliness.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: I don't really need to be remembered. I hope the music's remembered.
quotes.author: Jeff Buckley

quotes.quote: When you're a little kid, you just like music that makes you happy and is fun. As you get older, you reach college or your 20s and you decide that music should be challenging and all art should be smart. So you start to think it makes you like high art more to put down things you consider low art. I don't even think things are low art.
quotes.author: Patrick Stump

quotes.quote: You know, one of the tragedies of real life is that there is no background music.
quotes.author: Annie Proulx

quotes.quote: Some people have lives; some people have music.
quotes.author: John Green,  Will Grayson, Will Grayson

quotes.quote: If I were not a physicist, I would probably be a musician. I often think in music. I live my daydreams in music. I see my life in terms of music.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Balance is key. Balance is a virtue. Balance is next to godliness, maybe. We should all aspire to better balance. Too much of what is said in this world is one-sided, and we need more balance - in our speech, in our music, in our art, in everything.
quotes.author: CeeLo Green

quotes.quote: Life is for the living.Death is for the dead.Let life be like music. And death a note unsaid.
quotes.author: Langston Hughes,  The Collected Poems

quotes.quote: Without deviation from the norm, progress is not possible.
quotes.author: Frank Zappa

quotes.quote: Music is the social act of communication among people, a gesture of friendship, the strongest there is.
quotes.author: Malcolm Arnold

quotes.quote: I had a dream of music and art and the big city in which I would get lost, where no one would know me and I wouldn't know anyone, where I would work at some ordinary job, and if one day I got up in the morning and decided I wasn't going to go to work anymore, no one would ask questions.
quotes.author: Ori Gersht

quotes.quote: As much as I love music, in my mind, photography is what makes me the happiest - that's for sure.
quotes.author: Julian Lennon

quotes.quote: There are two means of refuge from the miseries of life: music and cats.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: Life, he realize, was much like a song. In the beginning there is mystery, in the end there is confirmation, but it's in the middle where all the emotion resides to make the whole thing worthwhile.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Last Song

quotes.quote: If I should ever die, God forbid, let this be my epitaph:THE ONLY PROOF HE NEEDEDFOR THE EXISTENCE OF GODWAS MUSIC
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: After silence, that which comes nearest to expressing the inexpressible is music.
quotes.author: Aldous Huxley,  Music at Night and Other Essays

quotes.quote: I urge younger artists to know that you don't have to be anything you don't want. You can do whatever's comfortable for you. From the music I make, to the things I do in my life, I'm true to my R&B core. I have the capability to make pop records and crossover, but that's not my aim.
quotes.author: Trey Songz

quotes.quote: We should consider every day lost on which we have not danced at least once.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Things have gone beyond my wildest expectations and dreams, and I feel like I've been given so many blessings in my life, between my friendship with the guys in the band, our wonderful audience, being able to play this music, and then my family.
quotes.author: Trey Anastasio

quotes.quote: Music expresses that which cannot be said and on which it is impossible to be silent.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  Hugo's Works: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: The best thing about being a DJ is making people happy. There is nothing like seeing people get up from a table to dance or the expression on their face when they hear a song they love. I also love to educate people on music they have never heard.
quotes.author: Chelsea Leyland

quotes.quote: There is pleasure in the pathless woods, there is rapture in the lonely shore, there is society where none intrudes, by the deep sea, and music in its roar; I love not Man the less, but Nature more.
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.quote: People worry about kids playing with guns, and teenagers watching violent videos; we are scared that some sort of culture of violence will take them over. Nobody worries about kids listening to thousands - literally thousands - of songs about broken hearts and rejection and pain and misery and loss.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  High Fidelity

quotes.quote: But it is the nature of stars to cross, and never was Shakespeare more wrong than when he has Cassius note, 'The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars / But in ourselves.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: With few exceptions, music has been for some centuries the art which has devoted itself not to the reproduction of natural phenomena, but rather to the expression of the artist's soul, in musical sound.
quotes.author: Wassily Kandinsky

quotes.quote: One ought, every day at least, to hear a little song, read a good poem, see a fine picture, and, if it were possible, to speak a few reasonable words.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe,  Wilhelm Meister's Apprenticeship

quotes.quote: A painter, who finds no satisfaction in mere representation, however artistic, in his longing to express his inner life, cannot but envy the ease with which music, the most non-material of the arts today, achieves this end. He naturally seeks to apply the methods of music to his own art.
quotes.author: Wassily Kandinsky

quotes.quote: It's no good pretending that any relationship has a future if your record collections disagree violently or if your favorite films wouldn't even speak to each other if they met at a party.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby

quotes.quote: There are so many opportunities in life, that the loss of two or three capabilities is not necessarily debilitating. A handicap can give you the opportunity to focus more on art, writing, or music.
quotes.author: Jim Davis

quotes.quote: We are the music makers, and we are the dreamers of dreams.
quotes.author: Arthur O'Shaughnessy,  Poems of Arthur O'Shaughnessy

quotes.quote: It is essential to do everything possible to attract young people to opera so they can see that it is not some antiquated art form but a repository of the most glorious music and drama that man has created.
quotes.author: Bruce Beresford

quotes.quote: Where words leave off, music begins.
quotes.author: Heinrich Heine

quotes.quote: I don't know if One Direction will stand the test of time. I have a niece who goes crazy for them. But the only way to judge art is to wait and see if it becomes evergreen. This takes a bit of time. Adele is a very good musician and I'd like to sing with her. But, again, time will tell if her music will become evergreen.
quotes.author: Andrea Bocelli

quotes.quote: My goal is to be one with the music. I just dedicate my whole life to this art.
quotes.author: Jimi Hendrix

quotes.quote: I would hope my legacy would be bringing smiles to faces. Happiness with my music.
quotes.author: Janet Jackson

quotes.quote: And all the books you've read have been read by other people. And all the songs you've loved have been heard by other people. And that girl that's pretty to you is pretty to other people. and that if you looked at these facts when you were happy, you would feel great because you are describing 'unity.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: If I had my life to live over again, I would have made a rule to read some poetry and listen to some music at least once every week.
quotes.author: Charles Darwin,  The Autobiography of Charles Darwin, 1809-82

quotes.quote: There are two means of refuge from the misery of life -- music and cats.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: The only truth is music.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac

quotes.quote: Every musician, their goal in life is to play music that people love, and I've accomplished my goal. I was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame and left that chapter of my life and those people in the past. Good and bad, I've loved and am thankful for that chapter.
quotes.author: Steven Adler

quotes.quote: Why do beautiful songs make you sad?' 'Because they aren't true.' 'Never?' 'Nothing is beautiful and true.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: The bird, the pin, the song, the berries, the watch, the cracker, the dress that burst into flames. I am the mockingjay. The one that survived despite the Capitol's plans. The symbol of the rebellion.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Catching Fire

quotes.quote: Ah, music,"he said, wiping his eyes. "A magic beyond all we do here!
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

quotes.quote: You don't love a girl because of beauty. You love her because she sings a song only you can understand.
quotes.author: L.J. Smith,  Secret Vampire

quotes.quote: While it is true that Frank had a great sense of humor, he was also very serious about composing music. In reality there are only a handful of skilled players who can play his most complex pieces. It takes a lot of patience to learn and requires a fantastic memory.
quotes.author: Dweezil Zappa

quotes.quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
quotes.author: Benjamin Britten

quotes.quote: You're beautiful and sad,"I said finally, not looking at him when I did. "Just like your eyes. You're like a song that I heard when I was a little kid but forgot I knew until I heard it again."For a long moment there was only the whirring sound of the tires on the road, and then Sam said softly, "Thank you.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Shiver

quotes.quote: Music is ... A higher revelation than all Wisdom & Philosophy
quotes.author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quotes.quote: If you were music, I would listen to you ceaselessly, and my low spirits would brighten up.
quotes.author: Anna Akhmatova,  The Complete Poems of Anna Akhmatova

quotes.quote: I'm glad we had the times together just to laugh and sing a song, seems like we just got started and then before you know it, the times we had together were gone.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Look at a football field. It looks like a big movie screen. This is theatre. Football combines the strategy of chess. It's part ballet. It's part battleground, part playground. We clarify, amplify and glorify the game with our footage, the narration and that music, and in the end create an inspirational piece of footage.
quotes.author: Steve Sabol

quotes.quote: For a long time, music was hope. Now it seems music isn't enough to make me happy. It used to be that's all I needed to keep going. Now I need other things to take up the other parts of my life.
quotes.author: Juliana Hatfield

quotes.quote: Listen to them, the children of the night. What music they make!
quotes.author: Bram Stoker

quotes.quote: Music is your own experience, your own thoughts, your wisdom. If you don't live it, it won't come out of your horn. They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.
quotes.author: Charlie Parker

quotes.quote: I will never forget experiencing Venice for the first time. It feels like you are transported to another time - the art, music, food and pure romance in the air is like no other place.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Berkley

quotes.quote: I love inspirational R&B, like Mary J. Blige and Jennifer Hudson. I want to do that. That kind of music stays with you.
quotes.author: Ashthon Jones

quotes.quote: Life is all about the friendship and the love and the music. It sounds silly, but it is. I want to have that experience as much as I can as an adult, not as a kid doing something that people are telling her she has to do. If anyone gets in my way, I'm going to get them out of my way.
quotes.author: Fiona Apple

quotes.quote: Had I not come out with an inspirational CD, you perhaps would have never known that I feel like I feel, that all songs, all the music I've ever done is a gift from God.
quotes.author: Smokey Robinson

quotes.quote: So I wanted to sing inspirational music, and that's exactly how I approached it - only the words have been changed to declare my relationship with God.
quotes.author: Smokey Robinson

quotes.quote: Beautiful music is the art of the prophets that can calm the agitations of the soul; it is one of the most magnificent and delightful presents God has given us.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: I don't stand for black man's side, I don't stand for white man's side, I stand for God's side.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: I had a boyfriend who told me I'd never succeed, never be nominated for a Grammy, never have a hit song, and that he hoped I'd fail. I said to him, 'Someday, when we're not together, you won't be able to order a cup of coffee at the fucking deli without hearing or seeing me.
quotes.author: Lady Gaga

quotes.quote: Next to the Word of God, the noble art of music is the greatest treasure in the world.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: Hip-hop is more about attaining wealth. People respect success. They respect big. They don't even have to like your music. If you're big enough, people are drawn to you.
quotes.author: Jay-Z

quotes.quote: I can tell you, dearest friend, that if it became known how much friendship, love and a world of human and spiritual references I have smuggled into these three movements, the adherents of programme music - should there be any left - would go mad with joy.
quotes.author: Alban Berg

quotes.quote: I discovered after going to music festivals that I am a rock fan. I love the guitars, the phrasing, and the abandon of rock fans.
quotes.author: Beyonce Knowles

quotes.quote: If you're going to kick authority in the teeth, you might as well use two feet.
quotes.author: Keith Richards,  Keith Richards: In His Own Words

quotes.quote: Somebody just gave me a shower radio. Thanks a lot. Do you really want music in the shower? I guess there's no better place to dance than a slick surface next to a glass door.
quotes.author: Jerry Seinfeld

quotes.quote: In the 1960s when the recording studio suddenly really took off as a tool, it was the kids from art school who knew how to use it, not the kids from music school. Music students were all stuck in the notion of music as performance, ephemeral. Whereas for art students, music as painting? They knew how to do that.
quotes.author: Brian Eno

quotes.quote: You're like a song that I heard when I was a little kid but forgot I knew until I heard it again.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Lament: The Faerie Queen's Deception

quotes.quote: A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and gets to bed at night, and in between he does what he wants to do.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: The show business has all phases and grades of dignity, from the exhibition of a monkey to the exposition of that highest art in music or the drama which secures for the gifted artists a world-wide fame princes well might envy.
quotes.author: P. T. Barnum

quotes.quote: I was born in the '60s and grew up in the '70s - not exactly the best decade for food in British history. It was horrendous. It was a time when, as a nation, we excelled in art and music and acting and photography and fashion - all creative skills... all apart from cooking.
quotes.author: Heston Blumenthal

quotes.quote: A quiet secluded life in the country, with the possibility of being useful to people to whom it is easy to do good, and who are not accustomed to have it done to them; then work which one hopes may be of some use; then rest, nature, books, music, love for one's neighbor -- such is my idea of happiness.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Family Happiness

quotes.quote: Music is the universal language of mankind.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: If you have good songs and a real desire to make music, the next thing to do, instead of approach record companies, is to get yourself a really good manager because then it allows you to focus on your profession of being a musician. Then they can focus on the darker art of the record label and the music industry.
quotes.author: James Blunt

quotes.quote: I hope people half my age and twice my age will listen to my music - I want it to live forever and for my audience to feel like they have a friend in my music. Music is a spirit. It heals. It's an amazing thing to be loved and appreciated, and sometimes, music has not just been my best friend, it's been my only friend.
quotes.author: Hunter Hayes

quotes.quote: When you make music or write or create, it's really your job to have mind-blowing, irresponsible, condomless sex with whatever idea it is you're writing about at the time.
quotes.author: Lady Gaga

quotes.quote: I just can't listen to any more Wagner, you know...I'm starting to get the urge to conquer Poland.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: I used to think anyone doing anything weird was weird. Now I know that it is the people that call others weird that are weird.
quotes.author: Paul McCartney

quotes.quote: We are fans of Mozart and Beethoven, as well 'South Park' and Borat. We believe that we can attract many people who eschew the serious ambiance of concert halls and don't go to classical music concerts because of such reasons. However, there is a 'serious humor' on the stage: funny and ridiculous. That is important!
quotes.author: Aleksey Igudesman

quotes.quote: Magic exists. Who can doubt it, when there are rainbows and wildflowers, the music of the wind and the silence of the stars? Anyone who has loved has been touched by magic. It is such a simple and such an extraordinary part of the lives we live.
quotes.author: Nora Roberts

quotes.quote: Life is one grand, sweet song, so start the music.
quotes.author: Ronald Reagan

quotes.quote: To be creative means to be in love with life. You can be creative only if you love life enough that you want to enhance its beauty, you want to bring a little more music to it, a little more poetry to it, a little more dance to it.
quotes.author: Osho

quotes.quote: Live your truth. Express your love. Share your enthusiasm. Take action towards your dreams. Walk your talk. Dance and sing to your music. Embrace your blessings. Make today worth remembering.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I used to date the lead singer of The Cranberries, but she cheated on me. Turns out she had some turkey on the side.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

quotes.quote: I've always thought people would find a lot more pleasure in their routines if they burst into song at significant moments.
quotes.author: John Barrowman

quotes.quote: I'm not saying I'm gonna change the world, but I guarantee that I will spark the brain that will change the world.
